title: Original proof coordinates in the composed proof
statement: Let $n>0$, let $V$ be a Boolean proof-checking system with input length $n$, proof length $\ell$, and query count $r$, and let a seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ use $K$ auxiliary coordinates per seed. For every input word $w$, original proof $p$, and index $i<\ell$, the composed proof agrees with $p$ at the corresponding original-proof coordinate: its value at position $i$ in the initial block of length $\ell$ is $p(i)$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean proof-checking system $V$ with input length $n$, proof length $\ell$, and query count $r$
A seedwise three-CNF reduction for $V$ with parameter $K$
